**Finding (repaired and re-submitted): Compliant — no redline.**

I expanded the citation and rationale to capture the full basis:

- **No covenant to measure.** No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching restriction binds Northwind anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "hire", "employ", "directly or indirectly" and "twelve (12) months", plus full reads of § 12, § 16 and § 30, surface no such provision and no restricted-period language.
- **Quote now includes the carve-out language.** § 12.3 expressly preserves our freedom to hire "any person who responds to general recruitment" and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment — affirmative support for the compliant call.
- **Failed deterministic checks addressed.** The duration and general-solicitation carve-out checks are inapplicable in a no-clause scenario; I noted this expressly, along with the fallback terms we would insist on (mutual, personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from end of involvement, advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire) should Brightline later propose adding a non-solicit.
